x-card.description: DNS, cache, Workers, Pages, analytics and tunnels. Changes wait for approval.

accountId.title: Account ID
accountId.description: The 32-character ID of the Cloudflare account, shown on the dashboard's account home and in its Overview pages. Workers, Pages, KV, tunnels and Logpush are read in this account; a zone of another account is refused.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: The zones agents may use, by name. Empty: every zone of the account that the token can see.

token.title: API token
token.description: A user or account API token, limited to this account and its zones. Read permissions cover the read tools; add DNS Edit, Cache Purge, Workers Scripts Edit or Pages Edit only for the changes you want agents to request. The Global API Key isn't accepted.
